cohort: Original pilot: 100 Charades-TimeLens + 100 QVHighlights-TimeLens per model
intervention: Select existing LM-head weight rows, project 526 allowed tokens and scatter to original token IDs. No gradient updates.
input: Original native video inputs and original grounding prompt; no changes to prompt format
generation: Greedy, original model repetition penalty, max_new_tokens=512, EOS stopping
evaluation: Official TimeLens extract_time, Python integer round, first predicted span, no clipping or correction
runtime: PyTorch 2.6.0+cu124, Transformers 4.57.6, BF16, SDPA, 4 concurrent model replicas, 8 CPU prefetch workers, H200 141GB
